svg.title: Four leaf forms and four coral studies
svg.desc: Original construction studies: feather palm, fan palm, ginkgo, cannabis, branching coral, sea fan, foliose coral and a labyrinth analogue of grooved coral. Botanical silhouettes, branching topology and reticulation are distinct controls.
svg.text: Original geometry studies · morphology presets proposed for Izzi · 28 September 2026

g.text: Joined blade with separated outer segments
Radiating folds; a common attachment region
Fan blade, notch and forked veins
Stylized colony; fixed depth and deterministic seed
Reticulated network; not an ordinary tree
Nested contours and explicit front-to-back order
Rounded labyrinth inside a massive outline
Graphic analogue; no biological growth claim

svg.text: Stylized structural comparisons, independently generated. These are proposals, not production Izzi output.
